sloka: सीतातृतीय काकुत्स्थह् परिश्रान्तः सुखोचितः ।भरद्वाजाश्रमे रम्ये ताम् रात्रि मवस्त्सुखम् ॥२-५४-३५॥
transliteration: sītātṛtīya kākutsthah pariśrāntaḥ sukhocitaḥ ।bharadvājāśrame ramye tām rātri mavastsukham ॥2-54-35॥

translations.english: The exhausted scion of the Kakutsthas, used to comforts, stayed in the lovely hermitage of Bharadwaja for the night with Sita, as the third member (of the group).
